item.description:

Central Fens — Wisbech, March & central Fenland: Drizzle. High 21°C, low 17°C, rain chance 100%, winds up to 14 km/h.
Western Fens — Peterborough & Whittlesey: Light rain. High 22°C, low 18°C, rain chance 100%, winds up to 12 km/h.
Southern Fens — Ely, Chatteris & southern Fens: Light rain. High 21°C, low 17°C, rain chance 99%, winds up to 18 km/h.

A regional outlook from representative points across the Fens.
